author: /root/oraculo_metodo_r2
input: Raw UTF-8 JSONL bytes; each non-empty physical line is scanned as one JSON value.
scanner_requirement: Tokenized duplicate-preserving JSON scanner. Deserialization into map/dictionary before duplicate accounting is prohibited.

raw_paths.item_id_occurrences: all direct key occurrences named id inside $.item, preserving lexical order

encodings.DUAL_ID_CODEX_0_149: Exactly two $.item.id occurrences in lexical order: first ^item_[0-9]+$, second ^exec-[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$.
encodings.OPAQUE: Any other count, order, prefix, type or malformed representation.

normalization.SINGLE_EXEC_ID: normalized_web_call_id is the sole exec-* value.
normalization.DUAL_ID_CODEX_0_149: normalized_web_call_id is the second occurrence only because this rule is frozen before implementation.
normalization.OPAQUE: normalized_web_call_id is Unknown; never apply first-wins, last-wins or deduplication.
normalization.normalized_event_id: sha256(UTF8(thread.started.thread_id)||0x00||UTF8(normalized_web_call_id)) when both operands are known; otherwise Unknown.
normalization.raw_evidence: Always preserve raw line bytes and SHA-256.

state_machine.key: ordered vector of all raw $.item.id occurrences
state_machine.valid: Exactly one item.started precedes exactly one item.completed with identical key vector and accepted web action; no completion-before-start or second transition.
state_machine.physical_call_count: Count matched start/completion machines even when normalized identity is Unknown.
state_machine.normalized_call_count: Count distinct known normalized_web_call_id values only; otherwise Unknown.
state_machine.action_vocabulary: Use the frozen Codex witness fields for search query/queries and open_page/find_in_page url.
state_machine.unknown_policy: OPAQUE telemetry makes adherence/catalysis linkage Unknown but does not delete output, cancel the paired arm or remove the session from the ITT denominator.
